section_summary.extract_value: This section contains acknowledgments, noting that the research was supported by grant 1R15 DK088949-01 from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) awarded to Jennifer B. Webb, and stating that NIDDK had no role in the study design or publication decisions. It also thanks various university admissions offices, institutional research offices, named individuals, and the associate editor and reviewers for their feedback.
section_summary.evidence_source: "This research was supported by grant 1R15 DK088949-01 from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) to Jennifer B. Webb." "NIDDK had no role in the study design, collection, analysis or interpretation of the data, writing the manuscript, or the decision to submit the paper for publication." "We wish to thank our respective research team members, Associate Provost for Enrollment Management Ms. Tina McEntire and the UNC Charlotte Undergraduate Admissions Office, the Office of Admissions and Dr. G. Scott Jenkins and the Office of Institutional Research at North Carolina A & T State University, Undergraduate Admissions Director Mr. Anthony Brooks, Mr. Stanley Evans, and the North Carolina Central University Undergraduate Admissions Office. We also would like to thank Associate Editor Dr. Tracy Tylka and the expert reviewers for investing their time and providing instrumental feedback on earlier versions of this manuscript."
